params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

items.docs: Returns matching objects across every searchable type. Narrow with `type` (post/term/post-format) and `subtype` (post, page, news, category, post_tag).
